notes: #1–#6 are 20th-century postcards whose catalog numbers were read as years (1128–1408); skipped. #8 (Coning, 1699, the town from the east) is an alternative to #7. For P4, #21 (Frich wood engraving, 1859) and #22 (postcard from St. Hanshaugen, 1906) could replace #18 as a pair of general views 47 years apart, but both are black and white and middling. #24 (balloon view of the Royal Palace) is dated only 1899–1930. #23’s Commons date (1 January 1950) looks like a placeholder for the 1950s given in its title.
